jobs.title: Analytics Manager
jobs.human_reasoning_short: Materially relevant analytics leadership role with business translation, stakeholder partnership, and commercial insight requirements.
jobs.job_description: Analytics Manager at Publicis Groupe ANZ. Lead analytics work that turns campaign, customer, and commercial data into business recommendations. Partner with strategy, media, client, and commercial stakeholders. Required: analytics leadership, insight storytelling, stakeholder influence, and translating analysis into outcomes. Preferred: SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and agency/client experience.

jobs.title: Commercial Insights Lead

jobs.job_description: Commercial Insights Lead. Own commercial analytics, pricing and profitability insight generation, opportunity sizing, and strategic recommendations for growth. Partner with finance, sales, and leadership. Required: commercial analytics, market assessment, stakeholder leadership, and business case communication.

jobs.title: Customer Insights & CX Strategy Manager

jobs.title: Product Analytics Manager

jobs.title: Marketing Science Lead

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy Manager

jobs.job_description: Revenue Strategy Manager. Translate commercial and customer performance data into strategy, prioritization, and executive recommendations. jobs.title: Analytics Enablement Manager

jobs.title: Customer Analytics Consultant

jobs.title: Operations Excellence Manager

jobs.title: Media Insights Director

jobs.title: Change Manager
